# LIGHTS OUT — F1 Race Countdown

> Zero-dependency web app: millisecond countdown to the next Formula 1 Grand Prix, weekend session schedule in local time, circuit outline map, track weather. During a session it becomes a live timing tower (positions, sectors, tyres), position-flow chart, cars live on the circuit map, per-driver telemetry, race control messages and team radio links.

## Links
- App (GitHub Pages mirror): https://dvinerlove.github.io/f1-timer/
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/dvinerlove/f1-timer
- Full local version with official timing proxy: `node server.js` → localhost:8420

## Data sources
- jolpica/ergast (schedule), bacinger/f1-circuits (track geometry), open-meteo (weather), OpenF1 + livetiming.formula1.com (live timing)

## Pricing
Free. No account, no ads, open source (MIT).
